what: A session started from Today (Gas of the day 'Read it step by step', Weak-spot gym, a mastery tile, Review now, the quick tiles) ends on Practice when you press Back or ✕ before answering. Today was where you came from.
evidence: #today → #gotdGo → Back → '#practice practice'. Same for the Weak spot 'Compensation gym' and .mt[data-k].
fix: Record the origin view in startSession (SS.from=VIEW==='session'?SS&&SS.from:VIEW) and, in sExit and the summary's buttons, go(SS.from||'practice').

what: Due review ignores the difficulty level. A pattern that became due at level 3–4 (hag_malk, hag_nag, hag_malk_ralk) is served at level 1–2, where slip() hides Na, Cl and albumin and no gap question is asked. The gas cannot be solved: the answer 'Metabolic acidosis + metabolic alkalosis' has to be read off a normal-looking pH/PCO2/HCO3.
evidence: S.lvl=1; S.kinds={hag_malk:{n:1,c:0,box:0,due:1,last:1}}; startSession('due') → kind hag_malk, slip shows only pH, PvCO2, HCO3. Questions: pH 'Normal pH', primary 'No primary disturbance', read 'Metabolic acidosis + metabolic alkalosis'. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-phone-due-l1.png
fix: In the due branch, filter dueKinds() by kindsFor(sess.lvl), as the 'today' branch already does. Or run due items at max(S.lvl, KINDS[k].lv>=3?3:S.lvl) and pass that level to slip() and buildQs(). Make the 'N due' banner count only the kinds playable at the current level, or say 'N due (some need level 3)'.

where: nextItem() quick branch (strict:m!=='quick'); reflex branch genCase(...) without strict
what: Quick read and Reflex draw non-strict cases, so many gases sit on a decision boundary: Winter's edge, the acute/chronic band, AG 14±2 or Δ ratio cut-offs. The marked 'one right answer' is then only marginally right. That is unfair in a timed mode and teaches false precision. In a sweep, 30–97% of non-strict cases per kind failed clearCut(); for example hag_malk at level 4 failed 58/60.
evidence: genCase('hagma',4,{}) gave pH 7.22, PCO2 23, HCO3 9 with Winter's band 19.5–23.5. The PCO2 is 0.5 mmHg inside the edge, yet it is marked 'High anion gap metabolic acidosis', and interp's own 'unsure' note says a second process is possible. Sweep table: borderQuick (non-strict cases that fail clearCut) 2:hagma 38/60, 2:rac_c 51/60, 4:hag_nag 55/60.
fix: Pass {strict:true} in the quick branch (safeCase(...,{strict:true})) and in the reflex genCase call. If variety drops, keep strict but widen rnd ranges in rawCase rather than serving ambiguous gases.

what: Pressing H when the hint is already auto-open (hintMode 'open', the default for new users and for weak steps) sets C.assist[i]=1. A correct answer is then marked ✗ 'Right, with a hint.', counted as a miss, saved to mistakes, and resets the pattern's spaced-review box to 0, even though the hint was showing anyway.
evidence: Fresh state, startSession('steps'). Q1 hint visible (hintMode 'open'). Press 'h', then answer correctly → qblock class 'qblock miss', text 'Right, with a hint.', assist=1. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-steps-hintH.png
fix: In useHint(i), return early if hintMode(C.q[i].cat)==='open' (the hint is already showing and is not penalised). Also return early when hintMode is 'off', so 'never' really means never, unless that bypass is intended (then label it).

what: Leaving a session through the tab bar (or any go()) silently drops it. There is no summary, no S.sess entry and no way to resume, and the answered gases vanish from session history (step stats are still recorded). For timed Boss/Final runs, leaveSession clears the clock but leaves SS live. If the session view is re-entered, the countdown is frozen and the deadline never fires.
evidence: startSession('final'); answer 1; go('today'); go('session') → #bT reads 9:58 and still 9:58 1.6 s later. Nothing in the UI offers 'Resume' or ends the run.
fix: On leaving with SS.res.length>0 and !SS.done, call finishSession(true) silently (store S.sess), or keep SS and show a 'Resume session (3/10)' banner on Practice and Today. On resume, restart the clock interval when SS.deadline is set (move the setInterval into a startClock() used by both startSession and RENDER.session). Ask for confirmation before leaving a timed Boss/Final.

where: nextItem() final branch: why: comp.v+'. '+comp.d; reflexAnswer() wrong branch
what: Wrong-answer feedback in the Final (and in Reflex) explains only the compensation step. Most distractors differ by gap or Δ-ratio findings ('HAGMA + metabolic alkalosis' vs 'Metabolic alkalosis'), so the learner is never shown why their pick was wrong. Reflex shows comp.d without its verdict ('Measured 17.8.' but never 'so chronic') and, at level ≥3, only gap.v without the arithmetic.
evidence: Final: '80-year-old with heart failure on high-dose furosemide', picked 'HAGMA + metabolic alkalosis'. Feedback: 'Appropriate respiratory compensation. Expected PCO₂ = 0.7 × 42 + 20 …' with no AG (142 − (88+42) = 12, normal). Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-final-wrong.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-reflex-wrong.png
fix: Build the why from all decisive steps: comp.v + comp.d, then gap.v + gap.d (when the label or the chosen distractor involves HAGMA/NAGMA/hidden alkalosis), then the Δ ratio when present. Better: render stepsHTML(c.o) in a collapsible 'Show the full working' under the answer, as caseFeedback does.

what: A full Compensation gym session or a module check (boss) never marks the day as active and adds nothing to the day's gas count. Only S.sess is written. So gym-only or check-only days break the streak, leave the heatmap blank and give '0/7 days studied', while the same week card counts the work as 'gases'. The header hint promises the streak counts 'at least one gas, lesson or Round'.
evidence: Fresh state, startSession('gym'), answer all 10, then finishSession: S.days=[], S.dayN={}, streak()=0, todayN()=0, and Progress shows '0/7 days studied' and '0 day streak' next to '10 gases · 50%'. A 10-question boss session behaves the same (S.days still []). Source: ui2.js:211-212 has no touchDay, unlike the else branch at :213.
fix: In answerGym call touchDay(1) for gym and boss too, or touchDay() at least, so the day counts. Better: one helper logActivity(kind,n) that updates days, dayN and sess together (see idea 1).

what: The session summary shows the XP total ('420 XP') in Quiet mode. The stat block is not .gamey and has no Quiet check.
evidence: Quiet mode, finish any session (e.g. boss, final, steps) → the summary stats show '<n> XP'. A text scan of the summary finds 'XP'.
fix:
Add class 'gamey' to the XP stat div at ui2.js:243 ('
'+S.xp+'XP
').

what: Calibration does not measure what the user rated. The 'How sure?' picker sits on the final 'read' question, but the stored outcome is allAB (every earlier acid–base step right and unassisted). A user who is 'sure' of a correct full read but slipped on the pH step counts as 'sure but wrong'. The rating is also given after the earlier steps' feedback is already on screen.
evidence: ui2.js:162 S.conf.push({c:C.conf,ok:allAB}); the conf picker is on cat 'read' (ui2.js:72). The Progress card labels it 'how often you are right'.
fix: Store ok as the read answer itself (o===q.a&&!C.assist[i]), or move the confidence picker to before the first step and keep allAB, but label it clearly ('right on every step'). Do not push when C.conf is undefined.

what: In every session mode, answering re-renders #v-session with innerHTML. Focus drops to <body>, and nothing announces the result: there is no aria-live region in the session, and #toasts is the only one. A screen-reader user presses an option and hears nothing, then has to search the page for the next question.
evidence: kb2.py: startSession("steps"), focus the first .opt, press Enter -> activeElement BODY. Live regions after the answer: only #toasts (empty). The feedback "Answer: Alkalaemia. pH 7.52…" is in the DOM but not announced. Also, startSession leaves focus on BODY.
fix: Add one visually hidden <div id="sLive" role="status" aria-live="polite"> outside #v-session, and write the outcome into it ("Wrong. Answer: Alkalaemia. pH 7.52, normal 7.35–7.45"). After each redraw, move focus to the next unanswered question's h3 (give it tabindex=-1), or to #fbNext when the case is complete. On session start, focus the first question heading.

where: practice whatif hint (ui2.js:62) vs lesson ventchg
what: The step hint says 'Acutely, HCO₃⁻ moves only ≈ 1 per 10 mmHg of PCO₂' for every whatif item, including the over-ventilated retainer (PCO₂ falling), while ventchg teaches −2 per 10 for falls (the app's own 2/5 rule).
evidence: ui2.js:62 and ui2.js:88; c1.js ventchg body and keys.
fix: Hint: 'Acutely, HCO₃⁻ rises ≈ 1 per 10 mmHg rise in PCO₂ and falls ≈ 2 per 10 mmHg fall.' Check the whatif generator arithmetic uses −2 for falls.

what: Lowercasing step names breaks the 'pH' symbol: the verdict reads 'Missed: ph.'
evidence: Steps session, answer the pH question wrong → 'Missed: ph.' Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-steps-feedback.png
fix: Lowercase only the first letter when it is not part of a symbol (e.g. keep 'pH', 'Δ ratio'), or don't lowercase at all: 'Missed: pH, Cause.'

what: Which gas fits? feedback lowercases acronyms: 'Acute pulmonary oedema with shock gives hagma + respiratory acidosis', 'DKA day 2 after saline resuscitation gives hagma + nagma.'
evidence: startSession('fit'), answer any mixed-label case. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-fit-wrong.png
fix: Use a helper that lowercases only the first character when the label does not start with an acronym (labels are already sentence case), e.g. lab=/^[A-Z]{2,}/.test(l)?l:l[0].toLowerCase()+l.slice(1).

what: While you read the feedback for case 1, the counter already says '2 / 5' (and the progress segment for case 2 is highlighted), because the result is pushed before the feedback is shown.
evidence: Steps session, finish case 1 → bar reads '2 / 5' with case 1 feedback on screen. Final: after a wrong first answer, the bar shows '2 / 12'. Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-steps-feedback.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-final-wrong.png
fix: Show SS.res.length when the current item is answered (cur finished / fit.ans != null / g ans != null), else res.length+1.

where: answerQ() calibration: S.conf.push({c:C.conf,...}) with default conf 'think'
what: Calibration is always recorded, with a default of 'Think' when the learner never touches the Sure/Think/Guess control. Untouched answers fill S.conf with fake 'think' data and flatten the calibration curve. The control is also mouse-only (1–4 are taken by answers).
evidence: caseHTML: SS.cur.conf initialised to 'think'; answering the read without clicking a confidence button pushes {c:'think'}.
fix: Initialise conf to null and record only when chosen (or require a choice before the read options are enabled). Add keys S/T/G for sure/think/guess and show them as <kbd> hints.

where: gymItem() why strings in kPa mode
what: With units set to kPa, gym explanations mix units: 'Winter's: 1.5 × 12 + 8 = 26 (± 2 → 3.2–3.7 kPa)' gives the result in mmHg without a unit, then the range in kPa. Respiratory items ask 'PCO₂ 8.9 kPa' but explain 'PCO₂ is 27 mmHg above 40'.
evidence: S.units='kPa'; gymItem() samples (see sweep).
fix: In kPa mode, write '= 26 mmHg (3.5 kPa) ± 2 mmHg → 3.2–3.7 kPa' and 'PCO₂ 8.9 kPa = 67 mmHg, 27 mmHg above 40 (5.3 kPa)'. Apply the same to hintFor('comp') and hintFor('real') (24 × PCO₂ only works in mmHg).

what: The 'Compensation?' gym explanation stops at 'Measured 39.' with no verdict, so a learner who got it wrong has to work out the link themselves.
evidence: 'HCO₃⁻ 16, measured PCO₂ 39 mmHg' → why 'Winter's: 1.5 × 16 + 8 = 32 ± 2 → 30–34. Measured 39.'
fix: Append ' → above the band: the lungs are not keeping up, so there is an added respiratory acidosis.' (and the equivalents for below / inside the band).

what: Escape, the ✕ button and the browser Back button end a session instantly with no confirmation. If no gas is completed yet, the partly answered case is thrown away (although its steps were already recorded in S.steps).
evidence: Phone, steps session, answer 3 steps of case 1, press Back → VIEW 'practice', SS null, no summary.
fix: Confirm ('End session? 3 steps answered') when the current item is partly answered or a timed run is active. Either count the partial case in the summary or don't record its steps.

what: Reflex has no visible level control. The Difficulty selector does not apply to it, a learner cannot step down a level, and promotion happens only if they click 'Level N+1 →' on the summary of a run that just met the bar. If they miss that button, the tile keeps saying 'level 1' even though reflexStatus() knows they are automatic.
evidence: MODS_META('reflex') shows 'level '+(S.reflex.lvl||1); no other code changes S.reflex.lvl.
fix: Auto-promote when reflexStatus() >= S.reflex.lvl (with a toast). Add a small level picker (1–4, with automatic levels ticked) on the Reflex tile or at the session start.

what: (Possibly intended) With hints set to 'never', pressing H still reveals the hint.
evidence: S.hints='never'; startSession('steps'); press h → hint block rendered.
fix: Either block H when hints are off, or document in Settings that H still works on demand.

where: MODES.final.d and DEEP 'final' card (line 18); startSession toast line 99
what: The Practice 'Final check' card still says 'Ten right earns the Native reader badge.' in Quiet mode, and the toast 'No boss for this module yet.' is never rewritten.
evidence: Quiet scan of Practice: 'Twelve full reads in ten minutes. Ten right earns the Native reader badge.' Toast probe: 'No boss for this module yet.' unchanged.
fix: Quiet text: 'Ten right passes the final check.' Toast: 'No module check for this module yet.'

where: gapWhy() / genCase AG with 'Include K⁺' = Yes
what: The 'Include K⁺ in the anion gap' setting only changes the interpreter. Session explanations and generated cases still compute AG without K⁺ and use reference 12, so a user who switched it on sees 'AG 19, reference ≈ 16 (K⁺ included)' in the interpreter but 'AG = 139 − (95 + 11.1) = 32.9 … Reference ≈ 12' in practice.
evidence: Set S.usek=true. interp({…k:4.5}) → 'Reference ≈ 16 (K⁺ included)'. Then gapWhy(genCase('hagma',3)) → no K⁺ and 'Reference ≈ 12'.
fix: Either apply usek in genCase/gapWhy/hintFor/Δ ratio (add K⁺ and +4 to the reference), or relabel the setting 'Include K⁺ in the interpreter's anion gap'.

what: A single Escape ends the session immediately: after one or more answers it calls finishSession(true), with no confirmation. This happens even mid-Boss or mid-Final, and when the user was only trying to dismiss a hint bubble or a native picker.
evidence: enter.py: startSession("steps"), press 1, then Escape -> summary screen "STEP BY STEP · ENDED EARLY".
fix: Ask for confirmation on Escape when SS.res.length>0 (a small dialog: "End session? Your answers so far are kept" with the buttons End and Keep going). Or require Escape to be pressed twice within 2 s, with a toast after the first press.

where: Session timers (#rT reflex, #bT boss and final deadline)
what: Countdown and elapsed timers are visual only. There is no announcement at 1 minute and 10 seconds left, and the boss or final auto-finishes at 0 without warning. Under WCAG 2.2.1 the user should be warned before a time limit expires. The essential-timing exception is arguable for exam simulation but not for practice.
evidence: Code: SS.clock updates the textContent of #bT every 500 ms. There is no role="timer" and no live region. kb2.py: #rT has no live ancestor.
fix: Give the session bar time span role="timer" aria-live="off". At 60 s and 10 s left, write "One minute left" or "Ten seconds left" to the session live region. Offer the extended-time setting (see Ideas).

what: In sessions, the chosen reason is shown only by class="on" (style), with no aria-pressed. The case-library version (ui8 autopsyRow) correctly sets aria-pressed.
evidence: ui2.js l.154: data-why buttons get class "on" only. Compare ui8.js l.53.
fix: Add aria-pressed="true|false" to the data-why buttons, as in ui8.

what: Each candidate gas is a <button> that contains a whole <table> slip. Interactive content may not contain tables, so the semantics are flattened. The button name is about 200 characters ("Gas A · 1 ARTERIAL 37.0 °C pH 7.41 PaCO₂ 27 L mmHg …"), and there is no separate way to read the table.
evidence: snap-fit.txt: a button with a nested table.
fix: Render each gas as a <div> slip plus a separate "Choose gas A" button (aria-describedby pointing at the slip). Or give the button a short aria-label ("Gas A") with aria-describedby pointing at the slip.

where: startSession() timer from a previous timed session
what: If startSession() is called while a timed session (Final check or Boss) is still running, the new untimed session ends at once with 'Time up', 0/0. Going through Practice or ✕ first is fine, so this hits deep links and any code path that chains sessions.
evidence: startSession('final'); startSession('today') → 'MIXED SESSION · TIME UP … 0 GASES'. Same with boss → steps. Verified with page.evaluate.
fix: clearInterval/clearTimeout of the previous session timer at the top of startSession().

what: Little interleaving. In a 5-sum gym, 4 sums were Winter's for metabolic acidosis (HCO₃⁻ 11, 10, 8, 10) and 1 was metabolic alkalosis. The next Round leg (estimates) opened with Winter's again (HCO₃⁻ 9). No respiratory acute/chronic sums appeared, although the lesson promises 'Sessions shuffle disorders'.
evidence: Round legs 1–2. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-round-gym1.png
fix: Draw the rule round-robin (Winter's, met alk, resp acid acute/chronic, resp alk acute/chronic) and do not repeat a rule or an HCO₃⁻ value within one session.

where: Session summary · finishSession (line 237) and the case list
what: In the gym summary the list is headed 'CASES' and shows rows that only say 'Metabolic acidosis'. There are no numbers and no answer, and rows cannot be tapped, so a learner cannot review a missed sum. The verdict says 'use the hints', but the gym has no hints. In Step by step, 3 wrong steps out of about 35 gave '40%, Tough round', because a case scores all-or-nothing.
evidence: Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-round-gym-summary.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-round-steps-summary.png
fix: For gym/est rows show 'HCO₃⁻ 10 → 23 (you: 17)'. Make rows open a review. Give the hint advice only for modes with hints. Base the headline on step accuracy, with cases fully right as a secondary number.

where: Quiet mode (default on) · session summaries and confetti
what: Quiet mode is on by default (S.quiet true) and says it 'Hides XP, levels and badges'. Session summaries still show an 'XP' stat (6, 104, 222). Confetti fires on Round and case completion. The Learn subtitle says 'Each module ends in a boss fight'.
evidence: Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-round-gym-summary.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-round-finish.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-chat-debrief.png
fix: Hide the XP stat when S.quiet. Skip confetti() in quiet mode (or keep it only for module checks). Map 'boss fight' to 'module check' in quiet mode.

what: Plural is wrong for one: 'Revisit 1 mistakes'.
evidence: Summary after one missed gas: 'Revisit 1 mistakes'. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-summary-early.png
fix: 'Revisit '+n+' mistake'+(n>1?'s':'').

where: finishSession() stats label and case list for boss/final
what: The Module check summary counts '10 GASES' for ten lesson questions, and the 'Cases' list repeats the module title ten times ('Oxygen, CO₂ and the lungs' ×10), so the learner can't see which questions they missed. Gym rows likewise all read 'Metabolic acidosis'.
evidence: startSession('boss',{mod:'gas'}), answer all → stats '10 gases', list of 10 identical titles. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-boss-summary.png
fix: Label the unit 'questions' for boss and 'sums' for gym. In SS.res, store the question stem (truncated to about 70 characters) as the label for boss/gym, and link misses to the source lesson (b.lesson exists in the pool).

where: finishSession() msg for 1-item sessions (Gas of the day)
what: Gas of the day (n=1) all right gives 'Strong session.', because 'Perfect session.' needs n>=5, and the 'session' wording is odd for a single gas.
evidence: acc===1 && n>=5 condition; gotd len=1.
fix: For gotd use dedicated copy: 'Today's gas: every step right. Same time tomorrow.' or 'Today's gas: missed X.'

what: Time shows '1 min' for a 10-second exit and rounds 1m29s down to '1 min'. Reflex and gym runs are short, so seconds matter.
evidence: Escape after one gas → '1 min'.
fix: Show m:ss under 10 minutes.

what: Error-autopsy chips are four full-width dashed buttons stacked vertically under every wrong step. They take more height than the question itself and push the next question down. After one is tapped there is no acknowledgement apart from the 'on' state.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-steps-wrong.png
fix: Lay them out as an inline wrap row of small chips (flex-wrap, auto width), collapse to the chosen chip after selection ('Logged: arithmetic slip'), and add keys (Q/W/E/R or a/s/d/f).

where: caseHTML() qn badge for 'Right, with a hint'
what: A correct answer after a requested hint shows a red ✗ badge and red 'miss' styling next to the text 'Right, with a hint.' The message and the colour disagree.
evidence: Request a hint (button), answer correctly → ✗ + 'Right, with a hint.'
fix: Use a neutral/amber 'assisted' state (qblock class 'assist', badge '½' or '✓ꜝ') distinct from right and wrong.

what: The reflex explanation gives the comparison numbers but no conclusion: 'PCO₂ down 12 mmHg. Acute: HCO₃⁻ ≈ 21.6; chronic: ≈ 18. Measured 17.8.' It also never says why the chosen answer (here metabolic acidosis, with pH 7.43 on the alkaline side) is wrong.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-reflex-wrong.png
fix: Prefix with the pH logic and the verdict: 'pH 7.43 (alkaline side of 7.40) with low PCO₂ → respiratory alkalosis; HCO₃⁻ 17.8 matches chronic (≈18).'

where: caseHTML(): option kbd numbers and the "Show hint (H)" text
what: Shortcut numbers are read as part of every option ("1 Acidaemia"), and single-key shortcuts (1–7 and H) are on with no way to turn them off. WCAG 2.1.4 allows this only if they are active solely on focus, or can be remapped or turned off. They are guarded against inputs, so the risk is low (speech-input users).
fix: Mark the kbd aria-hidden="true" and set aria-keyshortcuts="1" on the button. Add a Settings toggle "Number-key shortcuts" (default on).

what: At 390 px the summary head puts the 110 px score box beside a 16 px pixel headline that wraps to four lines; '1720 XP' falls onto its own row; the 'Cases' eyebrow shows with an empty list; the quiet 'Today' button floats below as plain text.
evidence: Start a timed session then another (see the timer finding), or finish any session. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-sess-today-390x844-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Stack .sumhead under 480 px (`grid-template-columns:1fr`), hide the Cases block when empty, and put Go again / Practice / Today in one .btnrow with the same button style.

what: Which gas fits? distractors share none of the target's disorders, so the right gas is usually the only one with the right pH direction and can be spotted without predicting anything (feedback even says 'The others share none of its disorders').
evidence: COMPS filtering in newFit().
fix: At level ≥3, include one 'near miss' gas that shares one component (e.g. HAGMA alone vs HAGMA + respiratory alkalosis for salicylate, acute vs chronic RAC for a COPD retainer). The feedback should then explain the discriminating number.

what: The cause question is answered from the vignette alone (the vignette names salicylate, antifreeze or diarrhoea). It tests reading, not gas-to-cause reasoning.
evidence: e.g. 'Confused man found with an empty antifreeze bottle' → 'Ethylene glycol poisoning'.
fix: Offer a 'blind cause' variant at level 4: hide the vignette until after the read and ask 'Which history fits this gas?' with causes from kinds sharing the same level-1 label, so the gap, osmolar gap, K⁺ or lactate must discriminate.

what: Gas of the day is in MODES but has no tile in Practice, and Due review shows only when something is due. A learner on Practice cannot find either from there.
evidence: MAIN array in RENDER.practice.
fix: Add Gas of the day as a small tile (with ✓ once done today, from S.ui.gotd), and a greyed 'Due review: next due dd/mm/yyyy' tile when nothing is due.

what: The summary names the weakest step but doesn't offer a one-tap targeted drill.
evidence: Summary note 'Your weakest step overall is…'.
fix: Add a 'Drill <step>' button: for comp → gym; for gap/delta → a 5-gas steps session restricted to HAGMA/HAGMA+NAGMA/HAGMA+MALK kinds; for ox → level-4 quick with oxygenation only.

what: Shortcuts exist (1–7, H, Enter, Esc) but are not discoverable; nothing on screen mentions Esc, H only shows on the closed-hint button, and the Steam Deck/desktop user has no cheat sheet.
evidence: keydown handler.
